messages.攻撃後の精神力回復で(解析Ⅲから)実質ノーコストに連発でき、色欲脆弱で色欲スキル: A Lust Slash E.G.O that can be used repeatedly at effectively no cost (from Threadspin Ⅲ) thanks to SP recovery after the attack, boosting Lust skills' damage with Lust Fragility.
messages.精神力回復: 覚醒スキルは攻撃後に精神力を12回復する(解析Ⅲは18)。精神消耗: **SP recovery**: The Awakening skill restores 12 SP after the attack (18 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Its Sanity cost is 15, so at Threadspin Ⅲ her SP ends up higher every time she uses it.
messages.色欲脆弱: Ⅰコインが的中時に色欲脆弱1を付与する(解析Ⅲは2)。色欲の高火力ス: **Lust Fragility**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Lust Fragility on hit (2 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Use it together with allies who have high-damage Lust skills.
messages.味方の強化: 解析Ⅲから、攻撃後に本人を除くランダムな味方2名へ攻撃威力増加1を: **Buffing allies**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, after the attack, gives 1 Attack Power Up to 2 random allies other than herself. The targets are random and it only lasts that turn, so it is a footnote.
messages.パッシブ「空ける」: 毎ターン色欲ダメージ量増加1を得る。精神力が0未満ならさら: **Passive — Emptying**: Gains 1 Lust DMG Up every turn, plus 1 more if her SP is below 0.
messages.色欲スキルのアタッカーがいる編成で、先に撃って色欲脆弱を配ってから攻撃してもらう: In teams with Lust skill attackers, fire it first to hand out Lust Fragility, then have them attack.
messages.精神力が下がってきた人格のリカバリーにも使える。: It also works to recover an Identity whose SP has been dropping.
messages.必要資源は色欲2・怠惰2・傲慢2。侵蝕スキルは精神力回復が無く、脆弱(属性なし): It requires 2 Lust, 2 Sloth, and 2 Pride. The Corrosion skill has no SP recovery and adds Fragile (no affinity), so it is not suited to repeated use.
messages.耐性は色欲が耐性、怠惰・憂鬱が脆弱。: Its resistances are Ineffective against Lust and Fatal to Sloth and Gloom.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が4上がり、回復が18、色欲脆弱が2になり、味方への攻撃威力増加も加わ: **Ⅲ**: Power rises by 4, recovery becomes 18, Lust Fragility becomes 2, and Attack Power Up for allies is added. If you use it repeatedly, take it this far.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が2になり広域化する。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 2, making it multi-target.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド 理髪師: 色欲のS2で出血を重ねる人格で、色欲脆弱の恩恵を受: **[The Barber of La Manchaland](persona:1111)**: An Identity who stacks Bleed with her Lust S2 and benefits from Lust Fragility.
messages.薬指点描派スチューデント: S1と守備が色欲で、必要資源の色欲を出せ、出血を付与: **[The Ring Pointillist Student](persona:1109)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Lust, supplying the required Lust, and she inflicts Bleed.
